We ask each human annotator to select the better outputs based on the following aspects: (1) Grammaticality to measure correct language usage; (2) Coherence, measuring whether the text has proper high-level plot and is cohesive; (3) Content Richness to measure the diversity and informativeness of outputs; and (4) Overall Quality.
